# Real scanned manual (live-only fixture)

Tests that use this fixture skip when `real-manual.pdf` is absent. Nothing here except
`fetch.py`, `.gitignore`, this README and `ground_truth_sample.json` is committed.

- Title: TM 5-3895-332-12, Operator and Organizational Maintenance Manual: Hammer, Pile Driver,
  Self-Powered, Diesel (Koehring Model DA35), FSN 3895-443-4696. Headquarters, Department of the Army,
  29 January 1970.
- archive.org identifier: `micro_IA41152616_0581`
  (https://archive.org/details/micro_IA41152616_0581). Source PDF:
  https://archive.org/download/micro_IA41152616_0581/micro_IA41152616_0581.pdf
- Provenance: GPO/Readex microfiche collection (`us-government-printing-office`, `us-gpo`, `microfiche`);
  creator "United States. Department of Defense. Department of the Army"; scanned from microfiche at 400 ppi.
- Rights: the item page shows **no** rights, license or "possible copyright status" statement (verified on the
  details page and in `/metadata`: no `rights`/`licenseurl` field). Basis for public domain is that it is a
  US federal government work (Department of the Army technical manual, 17 U.S.C. 105). No quoted rights text exists.
- Source: 64 pages, 10,842,013 bytes (10.3 MiB), pages ~583 x 739 pt (some ~579 x 757), every page is an image
  (JPX, 3241 x 4108 px on page 5, about 400 DPI) plus archive.org's hidden OCR text layer (Tesseract; page 5 has about 2,100 chars).
- Built output `real-manual.pdf`: 64 pages, image-only (0 text chars), grayscale JPEG q80 at 300 DPI
  (min(source DPI, 300)), 27,037,885 bytes (25.8 MiB).
- Content: numbered chapters/sections and paragraphs (1-1 .. 5-2), two-column pages, numeric spec and torque lists
  (page 8), about 28 figures (list of illustrations on page 6; exploded views, a curve chart, photos), several tables
  (Tables 2-1, 3-1, 4-1 captioned; MAC and BII tables in appendices B/C; troubleshooting tables).

## Reproduce

    uv run python tests/fixtures/real/fetch.py

Downloads into `source/`, verifies sha256, builds `real-manual.pdf`, prints the output sha256. Idempotent.

- source sha256: `547d8d99f75abaff42eb1c937d6aab425b5c88270ba39bc40901d147c4bf10e1`
- output sha256: `7f803e1b30d7293fc077a632081a0edc853527618b9bf6e8b119c96a6b2c6704`
  (deterministic for the same PyMuPDF/Pillow versions; a different JPEG/MuPDF build may change it).

## Ground truth

`ground_truth_sample.json`: 20 blocks on pages 5, 6, 8, 9, 16, 25, 30 (headings, spec paragraphs and lists,
torque table, table rows, figure captions) with approximate bboxes and numeric tokens. Page numbers are 1-based PDF page indices.

### Verification (2026-10-29)

All five sample files were checked the way the pipeline checks itself: by disagreement between independent readers,
never by one model approving another. Each file carries a `verification` field with the method.

- Scanned fixtures (this directory, `parts-list/`, `old-scan/`): a blind Opus reader transcribed every block from a
  300 DPI crop with the block outlined and no access to the sample; its digit tokens were diffed against the sample,
  and the archive.org OCR text layer of the source scan served as a third reader. Result: parts-list 20/20 and old-scan
  8/8 agreed outright; the pile-driver manual had 6 disagreements, all resolved by eye: gt-09 was missing the
  "Lubricating Oil, Diesel Engine (√ lubrication chart, fig. 3-1)" row (added), gt-17/gt-18 omitted the interval
  check-mark cells ("x", added), and gt-02/gt-06/gt-13 boxes clipped a column or a line (widened). Old-scan boxes
  gt-02/05/06/07/08 were extended where they clipped a last line or word.
- Born-digital fixtures (`faa-amt/`, `nist-handbook/`): sample digit tokens were diffed against the PDF text layer
  inside each box. nist 20/20. faa 17/20 after two box fixes (gt-06 outlined the "1-14" row instead of the
  transcribed "1-8" row; gt-10 cut the paragraph's last line); the remaining three differ only in the text layer's
  word order (two table rows) or by the blue list-callout "6" that sits inside gt-17's box.
- Known hazard, by design: in the 1970 manual's typeface the glyphs 3 and 8 are nearly identical at scan resolution
  (both readers flagged 3-6/3-8/3-10, Table 3-1, row "3."). The samples keep 3 where the document structure makes it
  unambiguous (chapter-3 paragraph and figure numbers in sequence, row numbers 1-5). This is exactly the confusion the
  scanned-fixture tests exist to exercise.
- A human spot-checked the first blocks of the pile-driver manual on the review page (`build/gt-review.html`,
  regenerated by the scratch script used for this audit) and found them correct.

## Index of real-document fixtures

Each lives in its own subdirectory (the pile-driver fixture is the one in this directory) with `fetch.py`, `README.md`,
`.gitignore` and `ground_truth_sample.json`. All are US government works; all ground truth was model-transcribed and needs a human spot-check.

| Name | Kind | Pages | What it stresses |
|---|---|---|---|
| `real-manual.pdf` (this directory) | scanned, image-only (1970 Army TM, pile driver) | 64 | two-column typeset text, spec lists, torque table, figure captions, list of illustrations |
| `faa-amt/` | born-digital, figure-heavy (FAA AMT Handbook General, ch. 7, 2023) | 80 | two-column text with live text layer, 233 embedded images, vector tables captioned "Figure", fraction glyphs, part-number lists |
| `parts-list/` | scanned, image-only, table-heavy (TM 5-4110-231-24P RPSTL, 1979) | 61 | 9-column part-number tables, dot leaders, facing figure/table pages, uneven scan quality |
| `old-scan/` | poor-quality scan, image-only (TM 11-427 Barometers, 1944) | 57 | faded low-contrast type, microfiche borders, off-center pages, near-blank pages, chart page |
| `nist-handbook/` | born-digital, complex tables (NIST Handbook 44 2026, section 2.20 Scales) | 64 | side-by-side tolerance tables, space digit grouping, Word-export text-layer quirks, numbered paragraph hierarchy |
